hook: When you are on a job and the phone rings, what happens to that caller?
body:

A) They leave a voicemail

C) They call someone else

hook: Every job in your business fits in one of four boxes.
body:
Every job in your business fits in one of four boxes. This comes from Dan Martell's book Buy Back Your Time.

D - Delegation: low money, drains you. Returning missed calls.
R - Replacement: makes money, drains you. Chasing quotes.
I - Investment: low money, gives you energy. Family, health, learning.
P - Production: high money, gives you energy. Doing the job. Closing the sale.

Which box did you spend most of today in?

(We are not affiliated with or endorsed by Dan Martell.)

hook: Before I asked any owner to trust me, I audited my own business.

63 checkout links tested, one by one.
3 buttons that opened the wrong product.

hook: What do missed calls cost you? Check your own number in 20 seconds.
body:
A simple example.

A shop misses 10 calls a week.
3 of those callers would have booked a $250 job.
That is $750 a week. About $3,250 a month.

Those are example numbers, not a promise. Yours will be different.

There is a free calculator on our page so you can check your own in 20 seconds.

hook: What is an hour of your time worth?
body:
What is an hour of your time worth?

Dan Martell's rule from Buy Back Your Time:
Yearly pay divided by 2,000 hours, divided by 4. That is your Buyback Rate.

Pay yourself $80,000? Your Buyback Rate is $10 an hour. Any task you can hand off for less than that should not be yours.

For most local owners, the first task to go is the phone: answering calls and writing down messages.

Our AI Front Office answers your missed calls and emails you the message. 7-day pilot, $97.

(Not affiliated with or endorsed by Dan Martell.)
